clips.title: 美联储理事库克：按兵不动也是行动，再等下去会落后多少？

subtitles.en: In my view, financial conditions are too accommodated at a time when inflation remains stubbornly above target with no clear signs of disinflation and train.
subtitles.zh: 在我看来，金融环境过于宽松，而通胀仍顽固高于目标，且没有明确的去通胀迹象。

subtitles.en: The current stance of policy does not appear to be curtailing the AI buildout and equity prices contribute to support consumer spending.
subtitles.zh: 当前政策立场似乎并未抑制人工智能建设，权益价格也在支撑消费支出。

subtitles.en: As a result, holding our policy rate steady will lead to a positive and widening output gap and increasing inflationary pressure.
subtitles.zh: 因此，保持政策利率不变将导致产出缺口扩大且为正，并增加通胀压力。

subtitles.en: Indeed, we are seeing elevated inflation in a broad swath of goods and services.
subtitles.zh: 事实上，我们看到大量商品和服务的通胀处于高位。
en_highlights: broad swath of goods and services

subtitles.en: I see the act of holding the rate steady as much a monetary policy action as the act of increasing the rate.
subtitles.zh: 我认为，保持利率不变与加息一样，都是货币政策行动。

subtitles.en: Second, my vote reflected the urgency I feel to tackle inflation.
subtitles.zh: 其次，我的投票反映了我对解决通胀问题的紧迫感。

subtitles.en: Inflation has been above target for more than five and a half years and every additional day poses greater risk that price and wage setters will address their inflation expectations upward.
subtitles.zh: 通胀已高于目标超过五年半，每多一天，价格和工资制定者上调通胀预期的风险就更大。

subtitles.en: Furthermore, waiting longer to implement rate increases, risk getting behind the curve.
subtitles.zh: 此外，等待更长时间才加息，有可能落后于曲线。

subtitles.en: If we fall behind additional and larger rate increases may be required to catch up later, which could increase stress on our financial system and have unnecessarily damaging effects on American households.
subtitles.zh: 如果我们落后，之后可能需要额外且更大幅度的加息来追赶，这可能会增加金融系统的压力，并对美国家庭产生不必要的损害。
zh_highlights: 额外且更大幅度的加息

results.title: Who Is Lisa Cook, the Fed Governor at the Center of a Firestorm? - WSJ
results.snippet: Some 40 years later, Cook became the first Black woman to serve as a Federal Reserve Board governor in Washington, a powerful perch that gives her a voice in setting the trajectory of the American economy. Now, she is at the center of an unprecedented power struggle pitting the independence of the central bank against the authority of the president. On Monday, President Trump moved to fire Cook, 61, accusing her of committing mortgage fraud before she joined the Fed. [...] Cook, an academic economist appointed by President Joe Biden in 2022, has refused to go quietly, saying she considers her firing illegal and that she will fight it in a lawsuit. She hasn’t given an explanation for the two mortgage filings, which the Trump administration has alleged amount to a federal crime. No charges have been filed. data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
